name: @noldova/desktop.electron
description: Noldova Desktop's Electron main process and preload: it starts and connects to the runtime, opens the window, and owns the tray, notifications from the operating system, the menu bar on macOS, shutdown and updates.

coverageExclusions.reason: Composes the main process from Electron's own modules, which load only inside Electron; the desktop UI workflows run it.
Adapts Electron's sessions, webview guests and its will-attach-webview event, which load only inside Electron; the desktop UI workflows run it.
Adapts an Electron web contents, which loads only inside Electron; the desktop UI workflows run it.
Adapts an Electron session, which loads only inside Electron; the desktop UI workflows run it.
Wraps electron-updater's cache folder, network session and Electron request executor, which load only inside Electron; the desktop UI workflows run it.
Connects DetachedStart to Electron's parent port, which exists only inside an Electron utility process; the Windows start test runs it.
